test_title: PYST 34: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

#: KSB:: NVE: %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**Option 1) # = FNW, % = SAJ**

**For # (FNW) to KSB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a92ceb952df592d41706639bf5b6ba6c607dc9a0f2aadb8ad707196ca556405d.png] 

**For NVE to % (SAJ)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ea7aa088354ad7705b03d7fea5a66e50c45c978d6d43b659449a0fe8d29703f.png] 

Option 2) # = FUW, % = SAJ

For # (FUW) to KSB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8662870497b54aebda995120052eb4d7ef1f6a0e73bb9f6928ca3f83c52b1119.png] 

The pattern derived from FUW to KSB is: (+5, -2, +5).

For NVE to % (SAJ)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00638fa7a1f1952b93903800141d8c20aceea21d38b9b4d0dc16f9252f531419.png] 

Option 3) # = FNW, % = SAI

For # (FNW) to KSB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afe58e62a635fc08e6a2bd896cd5c99b61998e6d1a518a373773781175049871.png] 

For NVE to % (SAI)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6f200cfe08453a70e0fe76733cdcc049e3ec90c0493b911c1a425102f60b0c7.png] 

Option 4) # = FNW, % = SUY

 

For # (FNW) to KSB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84814d00658d185de4ca705b1d143c583c6bc4bc6f37f898d4330e9eca3579ad.png] 

For NVE to % (SUY)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0db80e1fff703fde920382695409211cd756894efc66990414bb289fbb55baf4.png] 

 

Thus, the analogy holds true only for **Option 1** where the pattern (+5, +5, +5) is consistent for both pairs. 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
